title: Gold Chevaliere - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Gold Chevaliere in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: The gold-armoured Chevaliere. Its Chromatic form drops Chevalam.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:

Bring Light, Dark damage. Fire, Ice is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: Where to Find the Gold Chevaliere
How to Beat the Gold Chevaliere
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Light, Dark is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It resists Fire, Ice, so that damage is halved.
